integrity: The source hypotheses and explicit matrix form were checked against the full article. The proof distinguishes direct row-space projection from the classical identity-block lift, and finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the direct row-space image of the Lee--Park \(E_1(m,n)\) family for odd prime powers and \(2\le m\le n-1\).
No Grassmannian optimality is claimed; the minimum subspace distance is \(2\).
The finite replay is supplementary; the all-parameter conclusion rests on the symbolic polynomial proof.
An equivalent ordinary-polynomial subspace construction under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Grassmann distance spectrum of a dihedral Toeplitz quasi-MRD family
